in_sanskrit.name: अनाल
in_sanskrit.meaning: Not having, or free from, pain or suffering
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Absence of suffering, misery, or affliction. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'an' meaning 'not' and 'ala' meaning 'suffering' or 'pain'.

in_hindi.name: अनाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: Free from suffering or misery in expectation. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'anal' which means 'not having' and the Hindi suffix '-a' which means 'free from'.

in_tamil.name: அனலா
in_tamil.long_meaning: He/she is free from pain or suffering. It is derived from the Tamil word 'anal' which means 'not having' and the suffix '-a' which means 'free from'.

in_telugu.name: అనాల
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is free from suffering or pain. It is derived from the Telugu word 'anal' which means 'not having' and the suffix '-al' which means 'free from'.

in_marathi.name: Anala
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anala हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Anala is derived from An (Sun) and Aala (Ray). This name is associated with the sun's rays, symbolizing strength, power, and illumination.

in_bengali.name: Anala
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Sun's Ray
in_bengali.long_meaning: Anala একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। In Sanskrit, Anala is derived from An (Sun) and Aala (Ray). This name is associated with the sun's rays, symbolizing strength, power, and illumination.
